name: wake-watch
description: Session wake, one Monitor for both sources: stays silent until the agent tracker queues a wake row for this session (an agent idle with an open task, looping or burning tokens, or a watched background process that ended) or, in a DevSwarm workspace, until new direct mesh mail lands in its mailbox, then prints one line so an idle session is woken. Reads small files of its own session (read-only, poll-based); no tokens while quiet. Each source has its own switch: agents.wakeWatch for the agent rows, devswarm.wakeWatch for the mesh rows (off: no mesh rows). Additive only: never replaces the unconditional cron fallback. The old verbs `devswarm wake-watch` and `agents wake-watch` of the former two monitors both run this watcher.
